# Cyber Kings (2026-11-13): formable hegemonies. GENERATED by _dev/scripts/hegemonies/gen_hegemonies.py - change the generator, not this file.

# $HEG$ = hegemony title key, $BLOC$ = region, $FOUNDER$ = the character (root / scope:attacker).
# Formation: every empire on the bloc whose hegemony is unformed (unheld) or missing, every empire the founder holds,
# and every empire with at least half its counties in the founder's realm becomes de jure part of $HEG$.
# Hegemonies left with no empires stay as titular titles (holders keep them).
ck_hegemony_absorb_formation_effect = {
	every_empire = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { hegemony ?= title:$HEG$ }
			title_capital_county ?= { title_province = { geographical_region = $BLOC$ } }
			any_de_jure_county = { count >= 1 }
			OR = {
				NOT = { exists = hegemony }
				hegemony ?= { NOT = { exists = holder } }
				holder ?= $FOUNDER$
				any_de_jure_county = {
					percent >= 0.5
					holder ?= { OR = { this = $FOUNDER$ any_liege_or_above = { this = $FOUNDER$ } } }
				}
			}
		}
		set_de_jure_liege_title = title:$HEG$
	}
}

# After a won Unite war: empires on the bloc now held or at least half held by the attacker's realm join $HEG$ de jure.
ck_hegemony_absorb_realm_effect = {
	every_empire = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { hegemony ?= title:$HEG$ }
			title_capital_county ?= { title_province = { geographical_region = $BLOC$ } }
			any_de_jure_county = { count >= 1 }
			OR = {
				holder ?= $FOUNDER$
				any_de_jure_county = {
					percent >= 0.5
					holder ?= { OR = { this = $FOUNDER$ any_liege_or_above = { this = $FOUNDER$ } } }
				}
			}
		}
		set_de_jure_liege_title = title:$HEG$
	}
}

# Gives $HEG$ to the founder (root), moves its capital to the founder's if that lies on the bloc, makes it primary,
# then fires $FOUNDER_EVENT$ for the founder and $WORLD_EVENT$ for every other player.
ck_hegemony_found_effect = {
	hidden_effect = {
		ck_hegemony_absorb_formation_effect = { HEG = $HEG$ BLOC = $BLOC$ FOUNDER = root }
	}
	create_title_and_vassal_change = {
		type = created
		save_scope_as = change
		add_claim_on_loss = no
	}
	title:$HEG$ = {
		change_title_holder = {
			holder = root
			change = scope:change
		}
	}
	resolve_title_and_vassal_change = scope:change
	hidden_effect = {
		if = {
			limit = { capital_county ?= { title_province = { geographical_region = $BLOC$ } } }
			title:$HEG$ = { set_capital_county = root.capital_county }
		}
		set_primary_title_to = title:$HEG$
	}
	add_prestige = 1000
	hidden_effect = {
		save_scope_as = ck_heg_founder
		trigger_event = $FOUNDER_EVENT$
		every_player = {
			limit = { NOT = { this = scope:ck_heg_founder } }
			trigger_event = $WORLD_EVENT$
		}
	}
}
